description:
## Goal

Make `and` and `or` return the selected operand on interpreter, JIT, and AOT. They are control-value operators, not boolean coercions: `a and b` returns `a` when `a` is falsey and otherwise `b`; `a or b` returns `a` when `a` is truthy and otherwise `b`.

## Proven defect

At the fz-tfn.64 work boundary on 2026-09-11, this production program was run through all three doors:

```fz
fn main() do
  xs = [1, 2]
  dbg(true and xs)
  dbg(false or xs)
end
```

Interpreter output is correct:

```text
[1, 2]
[1, 2]
```

JIT and AOT both print:

```text
true
true
```

The contradiction is direct in the existing implementations. `ir_interp::binop::eval_binop` selects and returns operand `a` or `b`; native `lower_bool_binop` coerces both operands to truthy bits, combines them with bitwise boolean operations, and returns a boolean.

Existing ticket and open-PR searches for and/or, boolean operators, truthiness, short circuit, and operand-return semantics found no owner.

## Correct model

The selected input value is the result. Native lowering must preserve the selected operand representation and type/layout rather than compute a new boolean value. If condition-only demand needs only truthiness, it may retain a condition lane as an optimization, but that demand must not become the semantic authority for value-producing uses.

Use the existing control/value representation and joins. Do not add an operator-specific value store, display-string dispatch, duplicate interpreter rule, or eager materialization path. `and` and `or` are also ownership-forwarding edges: retained origin and list/callable/container identity follow the selected operand.

## TDD signal

Begin with the proven list-valued reproduction on interpreter, JIT, and standalone AOT. Add controls for scalar, tuple, callable, and falsey `false`/`nil` selections; mixed representations; condition-only use; nested chains; and selected list ownership/origin forwarding. Assert that an unselected raising or effectful right operand is not evaluated; source semantics are short-circuit and native lowering must preserve them.

The result type, transport origin, call target/capture identity, InputDemand, and deterministic artifact must follow the selected operand. Unchanged compilation performs no work; unrelated edits do not invalidate the requested root.

## Strategy and deletion

Trace source lowering through `LoweredStep::BinaryOp`, backend IR, native lane selection, and type/origin consumers. Represent operand selection once using existing control and join concepts, then make interpreter and native consume that authority. Delete `lower_bool_binop` boolean-value coercion for value-producing uses and any duplicated truthiness/result logic it supersedes. Keep condition-only optimization only where exact demand proves the value is unobserved.

Run focused three-door tests, full library and serial fixture matrix, formatting, all-target/all-feature check, strict Clippy, deterministic artifacts/work proof, and a fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review. One ticket, one commit, one close.

## Ordering

This is independent of fz-tfn.64. That ticket must conservatively model `and`/`or` as operand-retaining today. This ticket blocks fz-tfn.62, which needs the same selected-operand joins for lazy guard control, and fz-tfn.60, the final semantic-fidelity and debris proof.

## Proven SSA blocker and ordering

The fz-tfn.62 guard cutover exposed the same selected-operand defect at an existing native join. In fn selected(value) when (value or 99) == value, interpreter succeeds while JIT and AOT fail Cranelift verification: a call consumes a value defined in a non-dominating sibling block. The current Goto coercion mutates the function-wide var_env; boxing an entry value for one branch overwrites that value's binding, and a later sibling/join then reuses the branch-local SSA value.

Make Goto coercions edge-local using the existing control/value join representation. Each successor receives its coerced selected operand without changing bindings visible to sibling blocks. Add CFG/dominance coverage as well as the ordinary scalar, list, tuple, callable, false/nil, nested, ownership and untaken-effect cases above. This ticket blocks fz-tfn.62 because its lazy guard control needs the same correct selected-operand joins; fz-tfn.62 retains ownership of guard Intrinsic Value-or-Miss semantics.
title: Make native and/or return the selected operand
